title: A journal of requests and gratitude
description: A personal way of returning to what matters in the familiar language of faith.

blocks.text: A person needs a journal that supports their own practice rather than offering the same universal questions.

quote.text: parts of it don’t align with my faith in Jesus and Biblical truth. The affirmations about “ a perfect job coming my way” are only true if that’s God’s will for me. It seemed more Eastern religion based talking of Zen, etc.

blocks.text: Let people create their own topics, keep earlier entries going, and compare answers over time. Free text stays available with no prompt.
The app should not decide for the person which event counts as an answer, or what their own experience ought to be.
